## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; confirmation: extremely poor sector participation (only Energy positive) and narrow leadership concentrated in Tech (Top 5: INTC, AMD, META, ORCL, VLO → Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)). Internals are mixed with several large-cap names BELOW TREND, supporting a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.07%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.13%). Technology shows isolated leaders: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weak: SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%), AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%), NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%). Communication and Consumer Discretionary also lag: NFLX CORRECTION (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%), SBUX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -6.44%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%), AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -18.10%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -10.86%). Weakness concentrated in Healthcare and select high-beta Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69%). Note MA (1W: -3.87% | 1M: +0.70%) and V (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +1.21%) show 1W vs 1M divergence — minor but monitor.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leadership concentrated; several names ABOVE TREND (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%)) while MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -2.07%) and NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51%) show mixed internals; sector breadth: Technology weak on 1W (-0.11%), overall participation poor.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft on the week with JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.34%) and sector down 1W (-0.95%); C ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +2.01%) is an outlier. Breadth: Financials negative this week and not confirming a cyclical push.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure with multiple large-cap declines: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -3.46%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -7.44%), PFE CORRECTION (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +3.87%); sector breadth: Healthcare weak (-5.30% 1W), signaling defensive flows are not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed strength (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%)) while reducing exposure to clustered healthcare laggards and travel-related consumer names (NVS, SYK, BKNG). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and poor broad participation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%). BEARISH: NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%), AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (only sector positive this week; monitor continuation). BEARISH: Healthcare and Materials, both showing strong downside and low participation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
INTC resistance near prior swing high — watch move above short-term pivot (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%)). NVDA support zone near recent lows (NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51%)). AAPL support to watch: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +7.10%). VLO momentum continuation level tied to 1M strength (VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+85): Adobe headline bullish yet ADBE is BELOW TREND (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -5.64%) — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution. D (+85): NextEra/Dominion merger news aligns with Utilities interest; sector not broadly constructive but D shows sentiment-confirmation. ABT (+80): Abbott FDA nod and ABT shows uplift in healthcare headlines while sector is weak — actionable catalyst to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
WMB (-70): Pipeline legal setback aligns with Energy volatility; WMB at risk within Energy. NFLX (-55): Weak Q2 outlook and NFLX CORRECTION (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%) — news confirms near-term pressure. INTC (-50): Negative analyst note contrasts with INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) — clear sentiment-price divergence to monitor for reversal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration. META ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) and VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%) showing relative strength. Key risk: extreme lack of breadth (Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive) and sentiment-price divergences (ADBE bullish headlines but stock BELOW TREND; INTC bearish headlines but stock ABOVE TREND).
